title: intake.ocr-request-status.v1
description: Producer-side state of an OCR re-run request, returned by POST /intake/v1/ocr-requests and GET /intake/v1/ocr-requests/{request_id}. OCR text itself is never in this body: an accepted job publishes a new immutable raw-package revision; the status only points at it. Conditional fields (result only on completed, error only on rejected/failed, attempt <= max_attempts <= 3) are enforced by the ocr_request_status rule, not here, so violations carry the status_invalid code.

job_id.description: Producer-assigned id; also present for requests rejected before a job ran (ledger entry).

attempt.description: Number of the current/last provider attempt; 0 before the first run.

max_attempts.description: Provider-error retry cap for this job; contract maximum is 3 (rule-enforced).

result.description: Required when state=completed: pointer to the published raw package carrying the new OCR revision.

deduplicated.description: True when the producer answered with an existing job instead of spending new quota (idempotent replay or same logical_id+variant+preset+config_version).
